item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00433","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C19","C12","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C19","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C19 is an unmistakable concrete drafting template for the child. It concerns the same statutory authority, the same island, and the same administrative history, and it repeats the child's full sequence of recitals almost verbatim. Its operative provision extended adequate shipping service and deferred the coastwise laws to January 1, 1958—the precise deadline and prior action recited by the child—while the child adapts that provision into an indefinite extension. C12 and C04 have weaker parallels involving presidential proclamations that alter statutory periods, but neither shares the child's distinctive subject matter or machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas section 21 of the Merchant Marine Act, 1920 ... provides ... if adequate shipping service is not established ... the President shall extend the period ...","parent_excerpt":"Whereas section 21 of the Merchant Marine Act, 1920 ... provides ... if adequate shipping service is not established ... the President shall extend the period ...","explanation":"The same lengthy statutory authorization is reproduced essentially verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas an adequate shipping service to accommodate the commerce and the passenger travel of Canton Island has not been established ...; and Whereas the extension of the coastwise laws ... is dependent upon the establishment of such adequate shipping service","parent_excerpt":"Whereas an adequate shipping service to accommodate the commerce and the passenger travel of Canton Island has not been established ...; and Whereas the extension of the coastwise laws ... is dependent upon the establishment of such adequate shipping service","explanation":"The child repeats the parent's distinctive factual predicate and legal dependency in the same sequence."},{"child_excerpt":"the period for the establishment of an adequate shipping service for Canton Island is extended until further notice ... and ... the coastwise laws ... deferred until ... such adequate shipping service has been established","parent_excerpt":"the period for the establishment of an adequate shipping service for Canton Island is further extended to January 1, 1958, and ... the coastwise laws ... further deferred to January 1, 1958","explanation":"The operative machinery is the same, adapted from a fixed five-year extension to an extension lasting until a later presidential proclamation."}]}
